title: Find the shapes no approved message has

cases.says: a field missing from the rejected message, or of another length, is reported when no approved message has it that way
values that differ as two purchases differ (card, amount, STAN, time, terminal) are not reported
a letter in place of a digit is reported although the length is unchanged
an accented letter is outside printable ASCII and is reported, although Java counts it as a letter
a binary field is compared by its length in bytes, not by the hex text of its value
a shape that any one approved message has is not reported, so the comparison is with all of them
a field absent from the rejected message is not reported when some approved message lacked it too

origin.section: 15.2. A Rejected Message Is Compared With Approved Ones by the Shape of Each Field
